mapper.sql: id, student_id, class_id, student_no, student_name, class_name, counselor, occurred_on, department_code, type_code, reason, disposition, inspection_scope, remarks, status, rejection_reason, version, created_by, handed_back_at, inspection_label, appeal_label
mapper.select: SELECT FROM violation_record WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT FROM violation_record v
ORDER BY occurred_on DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT AS bucket_key, AS label, COUNT(*) AS bucket_count FROM violation_record v JOIN department d ON d.code = v.department_code JOIN violation_type t ON t.code = v.type_code
AND v.status != #{scope.pending} GROUP BY ORDER BY bucket_count DESC, bucket_key

SELECT v.occurred_on, COUNT(*) AS bucket_count FROM violation_record v
AND v.status != #{scope.pending} GROUP BY v.occurred_on ORDER BY v.occurred_on
